chunks: ʿAlī, from his father, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Ḥammād, from al-Ḥalabī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man who kills his son: is he to be killed for him? He said, “No.”

key_terms.أَ يُقْتَلُ بِهِ: is he to be killed for him; meaning subject to retaliatory execution
key_terms.لَا: no; the Imam’s ruling in response
key_terms.يَقْتُلُ: kills; refers here to the act of homicide
key_terms.ٱبْنَهُ: his son; the victim in this legal case

ai.seo_question: Is a father executed in qisas for killing his son according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a father who kills his son. Imam Abu ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام states that the father is not subject to retaliatory execution for killing his son.
